objective: Implement FastAPI routes POST /reports and GET /reports/{job_id} with pydantic request/response schemas satisfying contracts C2 and C6, with API tests covering 202, 200-running, and 404 cases using a fake JobStore

concepts: FastAPI router pattern used by health.py

non_goals: Do not touch app/db/**, app/services/**, or app/main.py
Do not add auth/authorization to the new endpoints (Stage non-goal)
Do not add streaming/SSE or a job listing endpoint (Stage non-goals)
Do not refactor the legacy CSV export router (Stage non-goal)
implementation_constraints: Follow the app/api/routes/health.py router pattern and app/api/deps.py DI for the DB session
Errors use the C6 shape {error: {code, message}}; 422 for invalid body, 404 for unknown id
The route must not start the worker pool (lifespace owns that in T04); it only persists the queued row and submits to the pool if one is present

deliverables.what: FastAPI router for POST /reports and GET /reports/{job_id}

acceptance_tests.description: POST /reports with a valid body {input: {...}} returns 202 and the body contains job_id (uuid)
acceptance_tests.evidence: pytest tests/api/test_reports.py::test_submit_returns_202 asserts response.status_code == 202 and 'job_id' in body

acceptance_tests.description: GET /reports/{id} with a job held in status 'running' returns 200 with status 'running' and progress an integer in 0..100
GET /reports/{unknown} returns 404 and the body contains error.code 'not_found'
acceptance_tests.evidence: pytest tests/api/test_reports.py::test_get_unknown_404 asserts status_code == 404 and body error.code == 'not_found'

acceptance_tests.description: POST /reports with a body missing 'input' returns 422 and the body contains error.code 'invalid_body'

failure_cases.scenario: malformed uuid string in the path
JobStore.get returns None for a well-formed uuid

handoff.notes: Record the exact response field list in verified_facts — T05 diffs it against C2
